info.name: DevTrack
info.description:
Local DevTrack API, grouped by domain (through 009-collaboration).

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:3000`).

**Auth:** HTTP-only cookie `devtrack_session`. Run **auth / Register** or **auth / Login** first. Enable the cookie jar (Settings → General → Cookies). Do not put a bearer token in headers.

**Errors:** `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.

**Suggested order:** health → register/login → users/me → create project → members → tasks → dashboard → probes.

**Roles (project-members):** `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Creating owner is always OWNER. Add existing users by email (no invite email). EDITOR: project patch + task writes. VIEWER: read/list. Only OWNER manages members and archive.

**Task enums:** status `TODO` | `IN_PROGRESS` | `DONE`; priority `LOW` | `MEDIUM` | `HIGH`. Soft-delete is HTTP DELETE (sets `deletedAt`; no restore).

item.name: system
item.description: `system` domain. `/health` and `/ready` are public. Probe create/list require a session. Probes are a shared non-product list (no owner). Probe UI was removed from the React app; HTTP remains.

request.description:
Liveness. Does not query PostgreSQL.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "status": "ok" }`

Readiness via the `system` repository.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "status": "ready" }`
**503:** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`

Create a system probe. Body must be `{}` or omitted.

**Auth:** session cookie

**201:** `{ "id", "recordedAt" }`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`
**503:** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`

List probes, newest first.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "probes": [{ "id", "recordedAt" }] }`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

item.name: auth
item.description: `auth` domain. Register and login issue `Set-Cookie: devtrack_session` (HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age 7 days). Logout revokes that session only.

exec: pm.test('register issues a session cookie or returns an error envelope', function () {

request.description:
Create a user and authenticate. Email stored lowercase; unique case-insensitive.

**Auth:** none

**201:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }` + `Set-Cookie`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**409:** `CONFLICT`

exec: pm.test('login issues a session cookie or returns an error envelope', function () {

request.description:
Authenticate. Failed login uses a generic message.

**Auth:** none

**200:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }` + `Set-Cookie`
**401:** `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`

Revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

**Auth:** session cookie

**204:** empty body
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

item.name: users
item.description: `users` domain. Own profile only. No user directory.

request.description:
**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "id", "email", "displayName" }`
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

Update `displayName` only. Sending `email` is rejected.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** public user DTO
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`

item.name: projects
item.description: `projects` domain. List returns active projects the actor may see (owner or member). Default list excludes archived. Creating actor is `ownerUserId`. Archive/unarchive require OWNER. Create Project saves `{{projectId}}`.

request.description:
Create a project. Also inserts creating OWNER membership.

**Auth:** session cookie

**201:** `{ "id", "ownerUserId", "name", "description", "createdAt", "archivedAt" }`
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`

List active authorized projects (owned or member). No `includeArchived` query.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "projects": [...] }`

Read one authorized project. Archived GET is creating-owner only (members get 403).

**200** / **401** / **403** / **404**

Update `name` and/or `description`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived → `409`.

**200** / **400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

Set `archivedAt`. OWNER only. Idempotent.

**200** PublicProjectDto

Clear `archivedAt`. OWNER only. Idempotent.

**200** PublicProjectDto

item.name: project-members
item.description: `project-members` domain (009-collaboration). Roles: `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Add existing registered users by email. Only OWNER may add/update/remove. List is readable by any authorized member. Saves `{{memberUserId}}` from Add Member.

request.description:
List members for an authorized project.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "members": [{ "id", "userId", "email", "displayName", "role", "createdAt" }] }`
**401** / **403** / **404**

Add an existing user by email. Role must be `OWNER` | `EDITOR` | `VIEWER`. Set `{{memberEmail}}` to a registered user.

**Auth:** OWNER session

**201:** PublicMemberDto
**400:** `VALIDATION_ERROR`
**403:** `FORBIDDEN`
**404:** user/project not found
**409:** duplicate membership

Change a member's role. OWNER only. Demoting/removing the last creating OWNER is rejected by domain rules.

**200:** PublicMemberDto
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404**

Remove a member. OWNER only. Body `{}` or omitted.

**204:** empty body
**401** / **403** / **404**

item.name: tasks
item.description: `tasks` domain (004) + dashboard summary (008). Soft-delete via DELETE. List filters: optional `status` and/or `priority`. Kanban UI uses the same PATCH status. Create Task saves `{{taskId}}`.

request.description:
Summary for the caller's authorized active projects. No query params. Pending = TODO+IN_PROGRESS; completed = DONE; overdue = non-DONE with dueDate before UTC today.

**Auth:** session cookie

**200:** `{ "projectCount", "taskCount", "pendingCount", "completedCount", "overdueCount", "projects": [{ "id", "name", "taskCount", "pendingCount", "completedCount", "overdueCount" }] }`
**400:** if unknown query keys
**401:** `UNAUTHENTICATED`

Create a task. Required: `title`. Optional: `description`, `dueDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `status`, `priority`. Defaults: status `TODO`, priority `MEDIUM`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived parent → `409`.

**201:** PublicTaskDto (no `deletedAt`)
**400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409**

List non-deleted tasks for the project. Optional filters: `status`, `priority`. Enable query params as needed. Authorized members may list (including when archived, for creating owner).

**200:** `{ "tasks": [...] }`

Get one task. Soft-deleted → `404`.

**200:** PublicTaskDto
**401** / **403** / **404**

Update allowed fields. At least one required. Cannot change `projectId` / `id` / `createdAt` / `deletedAt`. OWNER or EDITOR. Kanban columns call this with `{ "status": "..." }`.

**200** / **400** / **401** / **403** / **404** / **409** (archived parent)

Soft-delete: sets `deletedAt`, does not remove the row. No restore API. Later GET → `404`. OWNER or EDITOR. Archived parent → `409`.

**204:** empty body
